fields.label: Scenario
fields.help: Optional. Scenario/theme identifier for ScenSyn (e.g. stochastic_dreams). Leave empty to keep the current scenario.

fields.label: Auto player input
fields.help: If enabled, ScenSyn will simulate player input automatically during the harness run.

fields.label: TTS emitter
fields.help: Select which TTS emitter to use during the run. “(unchanged)” means do not modify current selection.
